name: POLLUX
description: POLLUX is a comprehensive open-source benchmark for evaluating generative capabilities of Russian-speaking LLMs, featuring 2,100 manually crafted prompts across 35 task types with a novel criteria-driven scoring protocol enabling interpretable and scalable evaluation.
reputation: A relatively new but well-cited benchmark in the Russian LLM community, often referenced as one of the first broad open evaluations tailored to Russian-language generative models.
notes: Includes LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators trained for nuanced assessment, replacing costly human judgments.
